rationale: The audio download URL (https://contribution.usercontent.google.com/download?c=<signed-token>&filename=...&opi=...) is embedded in the conversation page HTML, but it can ONLY be fetched inside the browser's credentialed context. A reconstructed pure-HTTP fetch from a CDP snapshot (the canonical Gemini RPC shape: at-token + Network.getAllCookies cookie jar) redirects to accounts.google.com/signin instead of returning the audio. The endpoint requires host-bound browser credentials (origin-bound cookies / per-request SAPISIDHASH Authorization) that Network.getAllCookies does not expose and a node fetch cannot reconstruct. Same class as Claude generate/present: no replayable pure-RPC roundtrip.

live_evidence.generation: First track prompt failed server-side ('I ran into an issue trying to generate that track'); a second prompt ('Upbeat acoustic guitar melody, cheerful, instrumental, 15 seconds.') succeeded and produced a download-ready track (Apricot_Afternoon).
live_evidence.download_click_trace: Clicking 'Download track' -> MP3 fired ONLY: (1) an unrelated batchexecute rpcids=ESY5D activity-log POST ([["bard_activity_enabled"]]), and (2) an in-page fetch GET to contribution.usercontent.google.com/download?c=...&filename=apricot_afternoon.mp3 returning audio/mpeg 200 (744608 bytes), then a client-side blob:null/<guid> save (Apricot_Afternoon.mp3). No URL-minting RPC on click; the signed download URL is pre-embedded in the page HTML.
live_evidence.embedded_url_proof: The download URL is found directly in document.outerHTML (contribution.usercontent.google.com/download?c=...&filename=apricot_afternoon.mp4) — NOT minted by an on-click RPC.
live_evidence.in_page_fetch: In-page browser fetch(url, {credentials:'include'}) -> 200, content-type audio/mpeg, 744608 bytes, ID3 header (real MP3).
live_evidence.headless_replay_FAILED: Headless node fetch of the IDENTICAL mp3 URL with the full 5622-char google.com/usercontent.google.com cookie jar + correct UA + referer + sec-fetch-* headers -> HTTP 200 but content-type text/html, final_url redirected to https://accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier (login interstitial, 1.2MB HTML). Audio NOT retrievable via reconstructed RPC.
